# `scene.rename`: Rename

Renames an object; paths of its children change with it.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(subtree x path length + log n)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: name, set name

Leaf names are unique among siblings and may not contain `/`. Ids (`o:12`) never change, so they are the safest references.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | New leaf name; must be free among its siblings. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to rename (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"chest","target":"crate"}
```

Result: `renamed crate (o:1) to chest`
